list.title: Data Aggregators
list.subTitle: A data aggregator is a feature that enables structured notification handling after a workflow is triggered in a schedule. When a schedule executes a workflow, the data aggregator processes the execution data and prepares it for notification delivery (e.g., via <ntLink>Notification Templates</ntLink>).
